text: Our reporting takes 20 hours each week. We want to cut that in half.
Manual reporting makes us miss our weekly inventory decisions, so we keep overstocking.
Priya, our CFO, has final authority to approve this purchase.
The solution must integrate with Salesforce and support single sign-on.
Operations will run a pilot next week. If it passes, Priya will make the final purchase decision on October 15.
After approval, legal reviews the contract, security signs off, and procurement issues the order, in that order.
I lead operations and sit on the buying committee. I have already made the business case to Priya and scheduled the stakeholder review.
We are comparing Acme Analytics, an internal build, and keeping our current process.
